contributions.geometry_provenance: printed-rule detection on the rendered page: per-page frame = the Amount column band x one measured band per printed table row; a row's box is their intersection, in pct of the page as poppler renders it (rotation included)
contributions.note: Form A prints a single Address column; only city/state are carried (PRIVACY: the street line printed on the form is deliberately not transcribed). Filer wrote the city in lower case ('ogden'); normalized capitalization only.

contributions.anchor: Form A 'Total Contributions (to line 1 of report): 15.00'
contributions.detail: The single Form A row (Kevin Bryan, 9/14/24, 15.00) sums to 15.00 = the schedule's own printed total = the cover's CUMULATIVE line-1 cell (15.00). The cover's This-Report line-1 cell is a slashed zero and Last Report is 15.00, so this December-5 final report added nothing; the schedule restates the whole cycle, hence cumulative scope, not period scope. 3-line form variant, so there is no separate <=$50 aggregate line and no line-1/line-2 residual. No in-kind label appears anywhere on the sheet; the monetary-only convention closes exactly (a monetary-plus-in-kind reading is identical here because there are no in-kind items).

expenditures.anchor: Form B 'Total Expenditures (to line 2 of report)' printed as a slashed zero glyph
expenditures.detail: Form B (p127) is present and its 23-row printed grid is entirely blank. The filer wrote a slashed-zero glyph on the total line outside the grid; under the zero-glyph ruling that DENOTES zero, so zero rows sum to 0 = the printed schedule total = the cover's line-2 cells (Last/This/Cumulative all slashed zeros). No expenditure row exists to be missed.

itemized.notes: Brian Rowley, County Commission Seat C, 2024 December-5 FINAL report, handwritten. p125 = cover (3-line variant), p126 = Form A, p127 = Form B. Cover line-1 This-Report and all of line 2 are slashed-zero glyphs (transcribed as 0 by the zero-glyph ruling); the cover's Address block is BLACKED OUT BY THE COUNTY (redaction by the county, not left empty by the filer). This filing is NOT the known Rowley filer-arithmetic specimen: it has one row and one page and no page SUBTOTAL line, so no delta arises. Both sides close on the CUMULATIVE column, so this is not an incremental filing.
